verdict.rule: ADOPT iff a full-map candidate has NATURAL eligible net >= +2.0% @512 and >= 0% @128, token-0 saving >= 20% at both, worst session >= -2% at both; else ADOPT-BOUNDED iff FIRSTTOK net > 0% @512, >= -1.0% @128, token-0 >= 40% @512, worst session >= -5% @512; else REJECT. Oracle excluded (ceiling only).
